question: What intellectual attainment follows from oblations of milk-rice mixed with ghee?
premises: An oblation of milk-rice mixed with ghee is performed.
The result is becoming a treasure of knowledge.
The attainment is presented as a direct outcome.
inference: By offering milk-rice mixed with ghee, one becomes a repository of knowledge.
plain_english: Having made an oblation with milk-rice mixed with ghee, one would become a treasure of knowledge.
